cohort: Theoretical cohort of 165,000 nulliparous women with epidural analgesia experiencing a prolonged second stage of labor
finding: An extended second stage of labor up to 4 hours in nulliparous women with epidural analgesia was found to be cost-effective and resulted in more spontaneous vaginal deliveries but also increased risks of certain complications.
mod_finding: Extending the second stage of labor to 4 hours in nulliparous women with epidural analgesia resulted in more spontaneous vaginal deliveries and fewer operative vaginal and cesarean deliveries.
